## 1. Data

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

.libPaths(file.path(Sys.getenv("LOCALAPPDATA"), "R", "win-library", "4.6"))

library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(janitor); library(meta)
library(ggplot2); library(scales); library(metafor)
library(tidyr); library(stringr); library(forcats); library(writexl)
library(ragg)

proj <- normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
ruta_raw <- file.path(proj, "data/main_dataset_v3.csv")
out_dir  <- file.path(proj, "results")
tif_dir  <- file.path(proj, "figures")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(tif_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

STD_W <- 9; STD_H <- 5
gg_tiff <- function(p, name, w = STD_W, h = STD_H)
  ggsave(file.path(tif_dir, name), p, width = w, height = h, units = "in",
         dpi = 300, device = ragg::agg_tiff, compression = "lzw",
         background = "white")
base_tiff <- function(name, draw, w = STD_W, h = STD_H) {
  ragg::agg_tiff(file.path(tif_dir, name), width = w, height = h, units = "in",
                 res = 300, compression = "lzw", background = "white")
  draw(); dev.off()
  draw()
}

G_OSCURO <- "grey20"; G_MEDIO <- "grey45"; G_CLARO <- "grey70"; G_TENUE <- "grey88"

theme_paper <- function(base = 12)
  theme_classic(base_size = base) +
  theme(axis.line   = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.ticks  = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.text   = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.title  = element_text(colour = "black"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = G_TENUE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
        strip.text  = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
        legend.key  = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        plot.title  = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold", size = rel(1)))

forest_gris <- function(x, ...)
  forest(x, col.square = G_CLARO, col.square.lines = "black",
         col.diamond = G_MEDIO, col.diamond.lines = "black",
         col.study = "black", col.inside = "black", ...)

ci_prop <- function(x, n, conf = 0.95) {
  res <- mapply(function(xi, ni) {
    if (is.na(xi) || is.na(ni) || ni <= 0) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
    as.numeric(binom.test(round(xi), round(ni), conf.level = conf)$conf.int)
  }, as.numeric(x), as.numeric(n))
  data.frame(ci_low = res[1, ], ci_high = res[2, ])
}

num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dplyr::na_if(as.character(x), "-")))
abx <- c("ampicillin","amc","caz","ctx","atm","nalidixic_acid","nit","norfloxacin",
         "cip","tmp_smx","amk","gen","cro","carbapenem_resistance","esbl")

dat0 <- read.csv(ruta_raw, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                 na.strings = c("", "NA", "-")) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(across(all_of(abx), num),
         n_tested = as.numeric(n_tested), n_resistant = as.numeric(n_resistant),
         meta_year = as.numeric(meta_year), measurement_tier = as.integer(measurement_tier))

is_r <- grepl("Rondon", dat0$study_label_author, ignore.case = TRUE)
rr   <- dat0[is_r, ]
wsum <- function(col) { v <- rr[[col]]; w <- rr$n_tested; ok <- !is.na(v)
                        if (!any(ok)) NA_real_ else sum(v[ok]*w[ok]) / sum(w[ok]) }
comb <- rr[1, ]
comb$n_tested    <- sum(rr$n_tested)
comb$n_resistant <- sum(rr$n_resistant)
comb$prevalence  <- comb$n_resistant / comb$n_tested
comb$sample_type <- "Multiple (Blood + Urine)"
for (cc in abx) comb[[cc]] <- wsum(cc)

dat0$meta_year[grepl("P.rez-Lazo", dat0$study_label_author)] <- 2017

dat <- bind_rows(dat0[!is_r, ], comb) |> arrange(meta_year)

etiqueta_autor <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(sub("\\s*[\u2013\u2014]\\s*.*$", "", x))
  x <- trimws(sub("\\s*et al\\.?$", "", x))
  ifelse(x == "Castilla Torres", x, paste(x, "et al."))
}
dat$autor  <- etiqueta_autor(dat$study_label_author)
dat0$autor <- etiqueta_autor(dat0$study_label_author)

write_xlsx(dat, file.path(out_dir, "klebsiella_pneumoniae_amr_peru_v3.xlsx"))
message("Estudios: ", nrow(dat), " | Aislamientos: ", sum(dat$n_tested),
        " | TIFF -> ", tif_dir)
```

## 2. Pooled prevalence

```{r}
#| label: meta-principal
#| fig-height: 6
dat_ma <- dat |>
  filter(primary_report == "SI") |>
  mutate(casos = n_resistant, total = n_tested, year = meta_year,
         autor_corto = autor,
         prev_3gc = casos / total) |>
  filter(!is.na(prev_3gc), !is.na(casos), !is.na(total), total > 0) |>
  arrange(year) |>
  mutate(studlab = paste0(year, " - ", autor_corto))

m1 <- metaprop(event = casos, n = total, studlab = studlab, data = dat_ma,
  sm = "PLOGIT", method = "Inverse", method.tau = "REML",
  incr = 0.5, method.incr = "only0", random = TRUE, common = FALSE)

base_tiff("Fig_forest_3GC_main.tiff", function() forest_gris(m1,
  leftlabs = c("Year - Author", "Cases", "Total"),
  xlab = "Prevalence of 3GC resistance", smlab = "", digits = 2, colgap.forest.left = "14mm"))
```

## 3. Year

```{r}
#| label: metareg-anio
res_year <- metareg(m1, ~ year)
summary(res_year)

bubble_data <- dat_ma |>
  mutate(prev = prev_3gc, weight = m1$w.random / max(m1$w.random)) |>
  bind_cols(ci_prop(dat_ma$casos, dat_ma$total))

p_bubble <- ggplot(bubble_data, aes(x = year, y = prev)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), width = 0.35,
                colour = G_MEDIO, linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "black", fill = G_CLARO,
              alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = weight), shape = 21, fill = G_CLARO, colour = "black",
             stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 12), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_paper(12) +
  labs(x = "Study year", y = "Prevalence of 3GC resistance")
gg_tiff(p_bubble, "FigS1_metareg_year.tiff"); p_bubble
```

### Diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: diagnostico
es <- escalc(measure = "PLO", xi = casos, ni = total, data = dat_ma, add = 0.5, to = "all")
res_rma <- rma(yi, vi, mods = ~ as.numeric(year), data = es, method = "REML")
df_lm <- data.frame(yi = es$yi, year = as.numeric(dat_ma$year), w = 1 / es$vi)
fit_lm <- lm(yi ~ year, data = df_lm, weights = w)
base_tiff("Fig_model_diagnostics.tiff",
  function(){ op <- par(mfrow = c(2,2))
              plot(fit_lm, id.n = 3, col = G_OSCURO, col.smooth = G_MEDIO,
                   pch = 21, bg = G_CLARO, lwd = 1.2)
              par(op) }, w = 8, h = 7)
```

### Figure 3

```{r}
#| label: tendencia-abx
#| warning: false
abx_cols <- c("tmp_smx", "ctx", "cip", "carbapenem_resistance")
plot_dat <- dat_ma |>
  select(meta_year, n_tested, studlab, all_of(abx_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(abx_cols), names_to = "antibiotic", values_to = "resistance") |>
  mutate(antibiotic = factor(recode(antibiotic,

      carbapenem_resistance = "Carbapenems"),
      levels = c("CTX", "TMP-SMX", "CIP", "Carbapenems"))) |>
  filter(!is.na(resistance), !is.na(meta_year), !is.na(n_tested), n_tested > 0) |>
  mutate(rotulo_txt = sub(" et al\\.$", "", sub("^[0-9]+ - ", "", studlab)))

plot_dat <- plot_dat |>
  bind_cols(ci_prop(round(plot_dat$resistance * plot_dat$n_tested), plot_dat$n_tested))

rotulo <- if (requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = rotulo_txt), size = 2.6, colour = G_OSCURO,
                           min.segment.length = 0.2, segment.colour = G_CLARO,
                           max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1)
} else {
  geom_text(aes(label = rotulo_txt), size = 2.6, colour = G_OSCURO,
            hjust = -0.12, vjust = -0.5)
}
p_trend <- ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = meta_year, y = resistance * 100)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low * 100, ymax = ci_high * 100), width = 0.5,

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),

  theme_paper(12) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)) +
  labs(title = "Antimicrobial resistance estimates across study years in K. pneumoniae",
       x = "Study mid-year", y = "Non-susceptible isolates, %")
gg_tiff(p_trend, "Fig_trend_antibiotics.tiff"); p_trend
```

### Other antimicrobials

```{r}
#| label: meta-por-abx
#| warning: false
meta_abx <- function(data, col_prop) {
  df <- data |>
    transmute(year = meta_year, autor = autor, total = n_tested, prop = .data[[col_prop]]) |>
    filter(!is.na(prop), !is.na(total), total > 0) |>
    mutate(casos = round(total * prop))
  metaprop(event = casos, n = total, studlab = paste0(year, " - ", autor),
           data = df, sm = "PLOGIT", method = "Inverse", method.tau = "REML",
           incr = 0.5, method.incr = "only0", random = TRUE, common = FALSE)
}
meta_ctx  <- meta_abx(dat_ma, "ctx")
meta_tmp  <- meta_abx(dat_ma, "tmp_smx")
meta_cip  <- meta_abx(dat_ma, "cip")
meta_carb <- meta_abx(dat_ma, "carbapenem_resistance")

forest_abx <- function(m) forest_gris(m, leftlabs = c("Year - Author", "Cases", "Total"), smlab = "", digits = 2,
                                     xlab = "Proportion resistant", colgap.forest.left = "14mm")
base_tiff("FigS5_forest_CTX.tiff",         function() forest_abx(meta_ctx))
base_tiff("Fig_forest_TMP_SMX.tiff",       function() forest_abx(meta_tmp))
base_tiff("Fig_forest_CIP.tiff",           function() forest_abx(meta_cip))
base_tiff("FigS4_forest_carbapenems.tiff", function() forest_abx(meta_carb))
```

### ESBL

```{r}
#| label: blee-vs-3gc
#| warning: false
dat_blee <- dat_ma |> filter(!is.na(n_tested), !is.na(n_resistant), !is.na(esbl),
                             measurement_tier < 3)
es_blee <- escalc(measure = "PLO", xi = n_resistant, ni = n_tested, data = dat_blee)
meta_blee <- rma(yi, vi, mods = ~ esbl, data = es_blee, method = "REML")
summary(meta_blee)

p_val <- coef(summary(meta_blee))["esbl", "pval"]
newdat <- data.frame(esbl = seq(min(dat_blee$esbl), max(dat_blee$esbl), length.out = 100))
pred <- predict(meta_blee, newmods = newdat$esbl)
newdat$pred  <- transf.ilogit(pred$pred)
newdat$ci_lb <- transf.ilogit(pred$ci.lb)
newdat$ci_ub <- transf.ilogit(pred$ci.ub)

dat_blee <- dat_blee |> bind_cols(ci_prop(dat_blee$n_resistant, dat_blee$n_tested))

p_blee <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = newdat, aes(x = esbl, ymin = ci_lb, ymax = ci_ub),
              fill = G_CLARO, alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_errorbar(data = dat_blee, aes(x = esbl, ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
                width = 0.02, colour = G_MEDIO, linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_line(data = newdat, aes(x = esbl, y = pred), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = dat_blee, aes(x = esbl, y = n_resistant / n_tested, size = n_tested),
             shape = 21, colour = "black", fill = G_CLARO, stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of ESBL-positive isolates",
       y = "Prevalence of 3GC resistance") +
  theme_paper(13)
gg_tiff(p_blee, "FigS3_metareg_ESBL.tiff"); p_blee
```

## 4. Specimen

```{r}
#| label: multivariada
#| warning: false
kpn_multi <- dat0 |>
  filter(primary_report == "SI") |>
  mutate(
    grupo = case_when(
      grepl("^Blood", sample_type) ~ "sangre",
      grepl("^Urine", sample_type) ~ "orina",
      TRUE ~ "otros"),
    year_meta = meta_year, n_3gc_r = n_resistant, prev_3gc = n_3gc_r / n_tested) |>
  filter(grupo %in% c("orina", "sangre"), !is.na(prev_3gc)) |>
  mutate(grupo2 = factor(grupo, levels = c("orina", "sangre")))

es_m <- escalc(measure = "PLO", xi = n_3gc_r, ni = n_tested, data = kpn_multi)
kpn_multi$logit_prev <- es_m$yi; kpn_multi$var_logit <- es_m$vi
rma_multi <- rma(logit_prev, var_logit, mods = ~ year_meta + grupo2, method = "REML", data = kpn_multi)
summary(rma_multi)

years_seq <- seq(min(kpn_multi$year_meta), max(kpn_multi$year_meta), by = 0.5)
pred_o <- predict(rma_multi, newmods = cbind(year_meta = years_seq, grupo2sangre = 0))
pred_s <- predict(rma_multi, newmods = cbind(year_meta = years_seq, grupo2sangre = 1))
df_pred <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(year_meta = years_seq, prev = plogis(pred_o$pred),
             lower = plogis(pred_o$ci.lb), upper = plogis(pred_o$ci.ub), grupo2 = "orina"),
  data.frame(year_meta = years_seq, prev = plogis(pred_s$pred),
             lower = plogis(pred_s$ci.lb), upper = plogis(pred_s$ci.ub), grupo2 = "sangre"))

kpn_multi <- kpn_multi |> bind_cols(ci_prop(kpn_multi$n_3gc_r, kpn_multi$n_tested))

p_multi <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = df_pred, aes(year_meta, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = grupo2),
              alpha = 0.30) +
  geom_line(data = df_pred, aes(year_meta, prev, linetype = grupo2),
            colour = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_errorbar(data = kpn_multi, aes(x = year_meta, ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
                width = 0.35, colour = G_MEDIO, linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_point(data = kpn_multi, aes(year_meta, prev_3gc, shape = grupo2),
             size = 3.2, colour = "black", fill = "white", stroke = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(orina = G_CLARO, sangre = G_OSCURO),
                    name = NULL, labels = c("Urine", "Blood")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(orina = "42", sangre = "solid"),
                        name = NULL, labels = c("Urine", "Blood")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(orina = 21, sangre = 24),
                     name = NULL, labels = c("Urine", "Blood")) +
  labs(x = "Study year", y = "Prevalence of 3GC resistance") +
  theme_paper(13) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
        legend.position = "bottom")
gg_tiff(p_multi, "FigS2_metareg_specimen.tiff"); p_multi
```

```{r}
  "Falconí-Sarmiento et al. (2016)",    2016, "Y","Y","U","Y","Y","U","Y","Y","NA",

write.csv(riesgo_raw, file.path(out_dir, "jbi_tabla_S3_v3.csv"), row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

riesgo_long <- riesgo_raw |>
  pivot_longer(i1:i9, names_to = "item", values_to = "juicio") |>
  mutate(
    item    = factor(jbi_items[as.integer(sub("i", "", item))], levels = jbi_items),
    juicio  = factor(juicio, levels = c("Y", "U", "N", "NA")),
    estudio = fct_reorder(estudio, anio, .fun = min),
    glifo   = recode(as.character(juicio), Y = "+", U = "?", N = "−", `NA` = "n/a"))

p_rob <- ggplot(riesgo_long, aes(x = item, y = estudio, fill = juicio)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = glifo, colour = juicio), size = 4, fontface = "bold",
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Y = "white", U = G_CLARO, N = G_OSCURO, `NA` = G_TENUE),
                    name = "JBI judgement",
                    labels = c("Yes", "Unclear", "No", "Not applicable")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Y = "black", U = "black", N = "white", `NA` = "black")) +
  theme_paper(12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(" \\((.*)\\)$", ", \\1", x)) +
  labs(title = "JBI critical appraisal of prevalence studies", x = NULL, y = "Included reports")
gg_tiff(p_rob, "FigS6_risk_of_bias.tiff"); p_rob
```

### Funnel

```{r}
#| label: funnel
funnel_gris <- function(x, main = "") {
  w <- x$w.random / max(x$w.random)
  op <- par(mar = c(8, 4.5, 1.5, 1.5)); on.exit(par(op))
  funnel(x, xlab = "Logit proportion", ylab = "Standard error", main = main,
         level = 0.95, ref = x$TE.random,
         pch = 21, col = "black", bg = G_CLARO, cex = 1 + 1.5 * w,
         studlab = FALSE)
  abline(v = x$TE.random, col = "black", lty = 2, lwd = 1.6)
  legend("bottom", bty = "n", horiz = TRUE, xpd = TRUE, inset = c(0, -0.36),
         legend = c("Studies", "Pooled effect", "Pseudo 95% CI"),
         pch = c(21, NA, NA), pt.bg = c(G_CLARO, NA, NA),
         col = c("black", "black", "black"), lty = c(NA, 2, 3), lwd = c(NA, 1.6, 1))
}

base_tiff("FigS8_funnel_overall.tiff", function() funnel_gris(m1))
```

```{r}
egger

loo_tab <- tibble(omitido = loo$studlab, prev = plogis(loo$TE),
                  ic_inf = plogis(loo$lower), ic_sup = plogis(loo$upper), I2 = loo$I2)[seq_len(m1$k), ]

         col.diamond.lines = "black", digits = 2, backtransf = TRUE,
         rightcols = c("effect", "ci", "I2"), rightlabs = c("Proportion", "95% CI", "I2"), colgap.forest.left = "14mm"))
```

## 6. Extraction sensitivity

```{r}
#| label: sensibilidad-extraccion
prep <- function(d) d |>
  mutate(casos = n_resistant, total = n_tested, year = meta_year,
         studlab = paste0(meta_year, " - ", autor)) |>
  filter(!is.na(casos), !is.na(total), total > 0)
fit <- function(d) metaprop(event = casos, n = total, studlab = studlab, data = prep(d),
                            sm = "PLOGIT", method = "Inverse", method.tau = "REML",
                            incr = 0.5, method.incr = "only0", random = TRUE, common = FALSE,
                            prediction = TRUE)
esc <- list(
  "Primario (un informe por estudio)"        = dat |> filter(primary_report == "SI"),
  "(i) Ambos informes de García"             = dat,
  "(ii) García 2016 en lugar de García 2012" = dat |> filter(!(grepl("García", autor) & meta_year == 2009)),
  "(iii) Sin proxy BLEE (nivel 3)"           = dat |> filter(primary_report == "SI", measurement_tier < 3),
  "(iv) Solo cefotaxima (estudios que la reportan)" = dat |> filter(primary_report == "SI", !is.na(ctx)) |>
                                               mutate(n_resistant = round(ctx * n_tested)))
tab_sens <- bind_rows(lapply(names(esc), function(nombre) {
  d <- esc[[nombre]]; m <- fit(d); n_tot <- sum(prep(d)$total)
  tibble(Escenario = nombre, k = m$k, N = n_tot,
         Prevalencia = plogis(m$TE.random), IC_inf = plogis(m$lower.random), IC_sup = plogis(m$upper.random),
         I2 = m$I2, PI_inf = plogis(m$lower.predict), PI_sup = plogis(m$upper.predict))
}))
write_xlsx(tab_sens, file.path(out_dir, "sensibilidad_extraccion_v3.xlsx"))
write.csv(tab_sens, file.path(out_dir, "sensibilidad_extraccion_v3.csv"), row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
knitr::kable(tab_sens, digits = 3)
```

## 7. Lima

```{r}
#| label: solo-lima
dat_lima <- dat |>
  filter(primary_report == "SI",
         grepl("Lima", location, ignore.case = TRUE),
         !grepl("regiones|Perú|Peru|nacional", location, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(casos = n_resistant, total = n_tested, year = meta_year,
         autor_corto = autor,
         prev_3gc = casos / total) |>
  filter(!is.na(prev_3gc), total > 0) |>
  arrange(year) |>
  mutate(studlab = paste0(year, " - ", autor_corto))

m_lima <- metaprop(event = casos, n = total, studlab = studlab, data = dat_lima,
                   sm = "PLOGIT", method = "Inverse", method.tau = "REML",
                   incr = 0.5, method.incr = "only0", random = TRUE, common = FALSE)

base_tiff("FigS7_forest_Lima.tiff", function() forest_gris(m_lima,
  leftlabs = c("Year - Author", "Cases", "Total"),
  xlab = "Prevalence of 3GC resistance in Metropolitan Lima", smlab = "", digits = 2, colgap.forest.left = "14mm"))
```

## 8. Summary

```{r}
#| label: resumen-resultados
pl <- function(m) c(plogis(m$TE.random), plogis(m$lower.random), plogis(m$upper.random))
fila <- function(nombre, m, extra = NA_character_) tibble(
  analisis = nombre, k = m$k, N = sum(m$n), casos = sum(m$event),
  prev = pl(m)[1], ic_inf = pl(m)[2], ic_sup = pl(m)[3], I2 = m$I2, tau2 = m$tau2,
  pi_inf = plogis(m$lower.predict), pi_sup = plogis(m$upper.predict), nota = extra)
m1p <- update(m1, prediction = TRUE)
resumen <- bind_rows(
  fila("3GC principal", m1p, sprintf("Q p = %.4g", m1$pval.Q)),
  tibble(analisis = "Egger (estadístico t; p)", k = m1$k, N = NA, casos = NA,
         prev = unname(egger$statistic), ic_inf = NA, ic_sup = NA, I2 = NA, tau2 = NA,
         pi_inf = NA, pi_sup = NA, nota = sprintf("p = %.3f", egger$p.value)),
  tibble(analisis = "Leave-one-out (rango de prevalencia)", k = m1$k, N = NA, casos = NA,
         prev = NA, ic_inf = min(loo_tab$prev), ic_sup = max(loo_tab$prev),
         I2 = min(loo_tab$I2), tau2 = max(loo_tab$I2), pi_inf = NA, pi_sup = NA,
         nota = "ic_inf/ic_sup = prev min/max; I2/tau2 = I2 min/max"),
  fila("Solo Lima", update(m_lima, prediction = TRUE)),
  fila("Cefotaxima (por antibiótico)", update(meta_ctx, prediction = TRUE)),
  fila("TMP-SMX", update(meta_tmp, prediction = TRUE)),
  fila("Ciprofloxacino", update(meta_cip, prediction = TRUE)),
  fila("Carbapenémicos", update(meta_carb, prediction = TRUE)),
  tibble(analisis = "Meta-regresión año (β logit/año; p)", k = res_year$k, N = NA, casos = NA,
         prev = coef(res_year)[["year"]], ic_inf = res_year$ci.lb[2], ic_sup = res_year$ci.ub[2],
         I2 = res_year$I2, tau2 = res_year$tau2, pi_inf = NA, pi_sup = NA, nota = sprintf("p = %.3f; R2 = %.1f%%", res_year$pval[2], res_year$R2)),
  tibble(analisis = "Meta-regresión BLEE (nivel 1-2; β; p)", k = meta_blee$k, N = NA, casos = NA,
         prev = coef(meta_blee)[["esbl"]], ic_inf = meta_blee$ci.lb[2], ic_sup = meta_blee$ci.ub[2],
         I2 = meta_blee$I2, tau2 = meta_blee$tau2, pi_inf = NA, pi_sup = NA, nota = sprintf("p = %.3f", meta_blee$pval[2])),
  tibble(analisis = "Multivariada sangre vs orina (β logit; p)", k = rma_multi$k, N = NA, casos = NA,
         prev = coef(rma_multi)[["grupo2sangre"]], ic_inf = rma_multi$ci.lb[3], ic_sup = rma_multi$ci.ub[3],
         I2 = rma_multi$I2, tau2 = rma_multi$tau2, pi_inf = NA, pi_sup = NA,
         nota = sprintf("p = %.4f; año β = %.4f (p = %.3f)", rma_multi$pval[3], coef(rma_multi)[["year_meta"]], rma_multi$pval[2])))
write.csv(resumen, file.path(out_dir, "resumen_resultados_v3.csv"), row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

ci_cp <- t(mapply(function(x, n) binom.test(x, n)$conf.int, dat_ma$casos, dat_ma$total))
tabla12 <- data.frame(id = dat_ma$id, autor = dat_ma$autor, meta_year = dat_ma$year,
  study_year_range = dat_ma$study_year_range, location = dat_ma$location, sample_type = dat_ma$sample_type,
  agent_used = dat_ma$agent_used, tier = dat_ma$measurement_tier, cases = dat_ma$casos, total = dat_ma$total,
  prop = round(dat_ma$casos / dat_ma$total, 3), ci_low = round(ci_cp[, 1], 2), ci_high = round(ci_cp[, 2], 2),
  weight = round(100 * m1$w.random / sum(m1$w.random), 1))
write.csv(tabla12, file.path(out_dir, "tabla1_2_v3.csv"), row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
knitr::kable(resumen, digits = 3)
```

## 9. PRISMA

```{r}
#| label: prisma
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 10.5

registro <- read.csv(file.path(dirname(ruta_raw), "full_text_decisions.csv"),
                     fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                     check.names = FALSE)
registro <- registro[registro$En_flujo_PRISMA == "SI", ]
capt <- grepl("^SI", registro[["Captado_PubMed_S4_2026-09-18"]]) |
        grepl("^SI", registro[["Captado_Scopus_S4_2026-09-19"]])

motivos_prisma <- c(
  E2 = "No Peruvian data",
  E3 = "Non-human isolates, animal or environmental",
  E6 = "Not a primary observational study",
  E4 = "Case or outbreak report without prevalence estimate",
  E5 = "Resistance-selected sampling; no population denominator",
  E1 = "Klebsiella reported at genus level only",
  E7 = "No K. pneumoniae-specific 3GC data",
  E8 = "Unpublished thesis")

excl_ft  <- registro[registro$Decision == "EXCLUIDO", ]
n_motivo <- sapply(names(motivos_prisma), function(k) sum(excl_ft$Codigo == k))
stopifnot(sum(n_motivo) == nrow(excl_ft))

hoja <- read.csv(file.path(proj, "search", "title_abstract_screening.csv"),
                 fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                 colClasses = "character", na.strings = character(0))
sin_consenso <- !nzchar(trimws(hoja$Consenso)) & !nzchar(hoja$Registro_ID)
decision_ta  <- ifelse(nzchar(trimws(hoja$Consenso)), hoja$Consenso, "YA EVALUADO A TEXTO COMPLETO")

no_recuperado <- registro$Decision == "NO RECUPERADO"
pendientes    <- sum(registro$Decision == "CANDIDATO")

prisma_n <- list(
  pubmed = 51, scopus = 31, other = sum(!capt),
  duplicates = 16,
  excluded = sum(grepl("^EXCLUIR", decision_ta)),
  not_retrieved = sum(no_recuperado),
  assessed = sum(!no_recuperado), excl_ft = nrow(excl_ft),
  included_reports = sum(registro$Decision == "INCLUIDO"),
  included = sum(registro$Decision == "INCLUIDO") -
             sum(grepl("informe secundario", registro$En_metaanalisis)),
  in_meta  = sum(registro$En_metaanalisis == "SI"))
prisma_n$identified <- with(prisma_n, pubmed + scopus + other)
prisma_n$screened   <- with(prisma_n, identified - duplicates)
prisma_n$sought     <- with(prisma_n, screened - excluded)
prisma_borrador <- any(sin_consenso) || pendientes > 0

with(prisma_n, stopifnot(
  sought   == nrow(registro),
  assessed == sought - not_retrieved,
  assessed == included_reports + excl_ft + pendientes,
  in_meta  <= included))

n_lab <- function(k) {
  v <- if (is.character(k)) prisma_n[[k]] else k
  sprintf("n = %s", if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) "___" else format(v, big.mark = ","))
}

caja <- function(x0, y0, x1, y1, txt, cex = 0.80) {
  rect(x0, y0, x1, y1, col = "white", border = "black", lwd = 1.1)
  text((x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2, txt, cex = cex, col = "black")
}
caja_lista <- function(x0, y0, x1, y1, txt, cex = 0.76) {
  rect(x0, y0, x1, y1, col = "white", border = "black", lwd = 1.1)
  text(x0 + 1.1, y1 - 1.6, txt, cex = cex, col = "black", adj = c(0, 1))
}
banda <- function(y0, y1, txt) {
  rect(6.0, y0, 12.1, y1, col = "grey45", border = NA)
  text(9.05, (y0 + y1) / 2, txt, srt = 90, cex = 0.82, font = 2, col = "white")
}
flecha <- function(x0, y0, x1, y1)
  arrows(x0, y0, x1, y1, length = 0.10, lwd = 1.1, col = "black")
linea <- function(x0, y0, x1, y1) segments(x0, y0, x1, y1, lwd = 1.1, col = "black")

dibuja_prisma <- function() {
  op <- par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0)); on.exit(par(op))
  plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 100), axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "",
       xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")

  banda(80.0, 97.0, "Identification")
  banda(30.0, 78.0, "Screening")
  banda( 6.0, 28.0, "Included")

  L0 <- 15; L1 <- 50; cx <- (L0 + L1) / 2
  R0 <- 56; R1 <- 98

  caja_lista(L0, 80.5, L1, 96.5, paste0(
    sprintf("Records identified (%s):\n\n", n_lab("identified")),
    sprintf("   PubMed/MEDLINE (%s)\n", n_lab("pubmed")),
    sprintf("   Scopus (%s)\n", n_lab("scopus")),
    sprintf("   Reference lists and other sources (%s)", n_lab("other"))))
  caja_lista(R0, 84.0, R1, 93.0, paste0(
    "Records removed before screening:\n\n",
    sprintf("   Duplicate records (%s)", n_lab("duplicates"))))

  caja(L0, 66.5, L1, 75.0, sprintf("Records screened\n(%s)", n_lab("screened")))
  caja(R0, 66.5, R1, 75.0, sprintf("Records excluded\n(%s)", n_lab("excluded")))

  caja(L0, 53.5, L1, 62.0, sprintf("Reports sought for retrieval\n(%s)", n_lab("sought")))
  caja(R0, 53.5, R1, 62.0, sprintf("Reports not retrieved\n(%s)", n_lab("not_retrieved")))

  caja(L0, 36.5, L1, 45.0,
       sprintf("Reports assessed for eligibility\n(%s)", n_lab("assessed")))
  caja_lista(R0, 31.5, R1, 50.0, paste0(
    sprintf("Reports excluded (%s):\n\n", n_lab("excl_ft")),
    paste(sprintf("   %s (%s)", motivos_prisma, sapply(n_motivo, n_lab))[n_motivo > 0],
          collapse = "\n")), cex = 0.70)

  caja(L0, 8.0, L1, 22.0,
       sprintf("Studies included in review\n(%s)\nReports of included studies\n(%s)\n\nStudies included in meta-analysis\n(%s)",
               n_lab("included"), n_lab("included_reports"), n_lab("in_meta")), cex = 0.78)

  flecha(cx, 80.5, cx, 75.3);  flecha(L1, 88.5,  R0 - 0.3, 88.5)
  flecha(cx, 66.5, cx, 62.3);  flecha(L1, 70.75, R0 - 0.3, 70.75)
  flecha(cx, 53.5, cx, 45.3);  flecha(L1, 57.75, R0 - 0.3, 57.75)
  flecha(cx, 36.5, cx, 22.3);  flecha(L1, 40.75, R0 - 0.3, 40.75)

  if (pendientes > 0) {
    rect(R0, 12.0, R1, 20.0, col = "white", border = "grey30", lwd = 1.1, lty = 2)
    text((R0 + R1) / 2, 16.0, cex = 0.78, col = "grey20",
         sprintf("Eligible reports awaiting inclusion decision\n(%s)", n_lab(pendientes)))
    segments(cx, 29.0, (R0 + R1) / 2, 29.0, lwd = 1.1, lty = 2, col = "grey30")
    arrows((R0 + R1) / 2, 29.0, (R0 + R1) / 2, 20.3, length = 0.10, lwd = 1.1,
           lty = 2, col = "grey30")
  }

  if (prisma_borrador)
    text(50, 2.5, paste("DRAFT -", paste(c(
      if (any(sin_consenso)) "title-abstract exclusions pending reviewers' consensus",
      if (pendientes > 0) "inclusion decision pending for eligible reports"),
      collapse = "; ")), cex = 0.62, col = "grey30")
}

base_tiff("Fig_PRISMA_flow.tiff", dibuja_prisma, w = 9, h = 10.5)
```
